text:
maria-ml: FYI nightly eval alert — `quantized-embed-suite` failed across multiple models (redwood/open-qa-v2 family). see CI summary below. marking P2 until we confirm scope. looking for owners :eyes:

ci-bot: nightly-run 1782506789 completed. failing_suites: [quantized-embed-suite]. failure_rate: 7.2% (threshold 1.0%). link: https://ci.internal.redwood/runs/1782506789 

alyssa: can you paste a couple failing prompt ids or a quick diff of float vs quant outputs?

maria-ml: pasted a minimal sample from the eval run:
```
prompt_id: qes_1423
prompt: "What is the capital of Zambia?"
float_out: "Lusaka"
quant_out: "Lundaka"  # hallucinated token insertion at start
```
Also seeing semantic swap errors for QA where answer is a wrong entity, and embedding cosine drift > 0.15 on 3k pairs.

rajiv: first checks: 1) was there a new quantization config rolled (quant4->quant5) in the runtime? 2) recent tokenizer or vocab changes? 3) dataset change for eval?

noah: i can repro locally with quant5 weights if someone points me at the model snapshot. running `./scripts/run_eval.sh --suite quantized-embed-suite --model redwood/open-qa-v2:quant5 --subset smoke` now.

olivia: we did a canary rollout to dedicated yesterday (2026-02-28 21:10 UTC) of open-qa-v2:quant5 for latency tests. not full prod.

maria-ml: ok assigning owners: @noah primary for repro + triage, @rajiv backup for kernel/quant config checks. i'll handle alert comms and eval evidence. setting interim severity to P1 if repro is consistent across seeds.

noah: repro update — I see the same token-level corruption on 4/20 sample seeds. Quick diff of logits shows spike in embedding layer quant scale at layer 3. suspect quant scaling mismatch.

rajiv: noted. i'll pull the quant calibration commits from yesterday: `git log --oneline --since=\"24 hours\" -- quant/` and check calibration scripts. also please capture a full model state hash and quant metadata: `metadata/quant.json` from the snapshot.

maria-ml: metadata link: s3://redwood-artifacts/open-qa-v2/quant5/1782499000/metadata/quant.json (includes per-layer scales). uploading failing examples to the alert ticket now.

alyssa: do we have float-run artifacts from the same snapshot for exact comparison?

noah: yes, float snapshots at s3://redwood-artifacts/open-qa-v2/float/1782498000. i'll run the paired diff script and paste a small table here when done.

ci-bot: regression-ticket created: INF-2314. linked run: https://ci.internal.redwood/runs/1782506789, assignees: noah, rajiv.

maria-ml: next steps agreed: 1) noah to reproduce and attach minimal failing snippet + logits (ETA 1h). 2) rajiv to validate quant calibration commit/scale mismatch (ETA 2h). 3) if confirmed, rollback quant5 on canary and block further rollouts; maria to notify product/support.

noah: quick repro attached in INF-2314 comment. initial finding: layer3 scale values differ between quant.json and runtime config in deployment (scale mismatch by factor ~1.8). will test re-quantizing with corrected scales.

rajiv: if that holds, likely a packaging bug where quant metadata wasn't batched into the model artifact. double-checking packaging pipeline `build/pack_model.py` and the artifact manifest.

olivia: creating a canary rollback PR now: #987. will hold until we confirm root cause.

maria-ml: thanks. i'll keep this thread updated and will escalate to SRE/infra if rollback needs infra change. tagging folks: @noah @rajiv @olivia.

alyssa: thanks team. once we have the little repro case and a clear root cause let's attach a short blurb for the release notes so we don't roll forward accidentally. :thumbsup:

noah: repro + minimal fix test passed locally after re-quantize with corrected scales — still running a few longer seeds. will mark INF-2314 with findings in 45m.

maria-ml: setting last_message_ts to 1782507050 and closing initial triage. follow-ups in INF-2314.
